At Digital Turbine, we make mobile advertising experiences more meaningful and rewarding for users, app publishers, and advertisers — intelligently connecting people in more ways, across more devices. We provide app publishers and advertisers with powerful ads and experiences that captivate consumers, fuel performance, and help telecoms and OEMs supercharge awareness, acquisition, and monetization. In a rapidly evolving industry, we are constantly innovating and creating better paths of discovery to connect consumers, publishers, and advertisers across the mobile ecosystem. Please note that Digital Turbine is a hybrid work environment-only candidates local to the posting location will be considered. The Mission: Engineering the Brain of DT Exchange At Digital Turbine, "Real-Time" is our reality - handling billions of events with millisecond-level constraints. Our DS team doesn't just build models; we build the algorithmic heartbeat of a massive global marketplace. We are currently in a peak phase of infrastructure evolution, and we need a Senior partner to help lead the charge. The Role: A True Problem Solver We’re looking for a Senior DS who thrives on End-to-End ownership. You aren't just given a dataset; you identify the business opportunity, architect the mathematical solution, and write the high-quality, production-ready code that brings it to life. This is the ultimate "DS Candy Store" for those who love research but live for the adrenaline of seeing their code drive real revenue. Who You Are: Have AdTech experience and understand the thrill of low-latency environments and high-stakes auction dynamics The Scientist-Engineer Hybrid: You have a 5+ year track record of delivering DS projects to production. An MSc/PhD in a quantitative field is a must Tech Mastery: Expert-level Python (production-grade) and the ability to build for scale ( Spark, ONNX - great advantage) The "Nose for Value": You are business-oriented and independent You don't just solve equations; you solve business problems and know how to measure your success Mentor & Partner: You lead by example, elevating the team’s technical bar through code reviews and collaborative design What You’ll Do: End-to-End Ownership: Own the entire lifecycle: from defining the business problem and KPI to deploying and monitoring the solution in production High-Scale Architecture: Design and implement ML models & handling high-cardinality data at massive scale Engineering Excellence: Write clean, modular, and scalable code. We believe great Data Science is built on a foundation of great Software Engineering Strategic Leadership: Mentor the team through complex technical hurdles and contribute directly to our algorithmic roadmap Why Digital Turbine? Because here, your impact is immediate and measurable. You’ll have the autonomy of a startup with the data-rich environment of a global giant. If you’re ready to move from the whiteboard to the "vein" of the product, let’s talk! About Digital Turbine: Digital Turbine (NASDAQ: APPS) powers superior mobile consumer experiences and results for the world’s leading telcos, advertisers and publishers. Our end-to-end platform uniquely simplifies the ability to supercharge awareness, acquisition and monetization — connecting our partners to more consumers, in more ways, across more devices. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas, with global offices in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, London, Berlin, Singapore, Tel Aviv, and other cities around the world, serving top agency, app developer, and advertising markets. We are honored to have achieved numerous awards as an employer of choice, around the world, including: BuiltIn's Best Places to Work Awards in 2022, 2023 and 2024, DUNS 100 Best Places to Work in Tech for 2023 and 2024, and BDICode's 100 Best Companies to Work in 2024. Digital Turbine is an equal opportunity employer committed to exemplifying diversity and inclusion around the world. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. We embed diversity in our mindset, products, and teams to empower an inclusive, equitable, and culturally fluent environment. Building and continuously fostering this culture within our teams makes us better collaborators, partners, and innovators. Digital Turbine will process the information you provide during the application process in accordance with the Digital Turbine Global Recruitment Privacy Notice .

Founded in 2019 by industry experts from Playtika and Rovio, the company strives to develop innovative and exciting casual games that captivate millions of players worldwide and remain enjoyable for years to come. • Dice Dreams, our flagship game, has become a global sensation and a top-100-grossing hit, while Domino Dreams, our next big success, is also making a significant impact in the industry. • Our Newest Game – A Magical Collaboration with Disney! • Released in 2025, Disney Solitaire brings beloved Disney stories and characters to life in an unforgettable gaming experience. • Our team, headquartered in Tel Aviv, is made up of talented, passionate, and ambitious professionals. And the future is even more exciting! Want to be part of our journey? Check out the job description below. • What will you do at SuperPlay?: We have petabytes of data, but data isn't insight. Your mission is to be the bridge between raw information and strategic action. This isn't about being a "dashboard provider" - you will be measured by the quality of insights you generate; it's about creating "aha!" moments by going beyond the "what" to uncover the "why" that drives player behavior and shapes our success. • This role is unique: our data is exceptionally clean. There is no ETL or technical pipeline maintenance. Our time is almost exclusively spent on thinking, brainstorming, learning, and researching. • In this role, you will: • Be a strategic partner to our product, design, and leadership teams. Your job is to bring them not just answers, but better questions. You'll translate your findings into compelling, actionable recommendations that catalyze new features, better experiences, and smarter business decisions. • Hypothesize, test, and build frameworks to understand how virtual economies thrive and how player incentives drive long-term engagement. • Embark on deep research projects to deconstruct our most complex business questions. Your deliverable will be a compelling narrative, backed by rigorous analysis, that guides our strategic business roadmap. • Focus on what’s important. We use modern tools (like LLMs) for brainstorming and automating the mundane. Your focus will be on the ambiguous, the complex, and the truly innovative. • Who are you?: Our definition of a good analyst is simple: someone who provides decision-makers with interesting insights. • There are varied archetypes and backgrounds that fit this definition, but some core traits are universal: • 2+ years of experience in the gaming industry/ more than 3 years of experience in Monetization. • You are a first-principles thinker with an innate need to break down complex problems to their fundamental truths. • You possess a deep-seated curiosity to understand human behavior. • You develop strong, data-informed opinions and aren't afraid to voice them. However, you are eager to be challenged and ready to be convinced by new evidence or a better argument. • You can effortlessly translate a complex statistical model into a clear, persuasive story for any audience, with an emphasis on C-level executives. • You are resourceful and self-driven, comfortable navigating uncertainty and motivated to find a path forward even when the way isn't clear • You get bonus points for:: The journey from a complex question to a clear insight is often accelerated by the right tools. Experience with the following is useful for this role (though not required): • A solid understanding of experimental design and A/B testing methodologies. • Proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets (e.g., strong SQL skills). • Experience using a scripting language like Python for data analysis and automation. • Familiarity with user analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel). • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker). •

We use modern tools (like LLMs) for brainstorming and automating the mundane. Your focus will be on the ambiguous, the complex, and the truly innovative. • Requirements: Who You Are: • You are a first-principles thinker with an innate need to break down complex problems to their fundamental truths. • You possess a deep-seated curiosity to understand human behavior. • You develop strong, data-informed opinions and aren't afraid to voice them. Morning is seeking a Business Product Analyst - a business-minded analyst who will work hand in hand with our Product Managers and Scrum teams as a true Business Partner. This is not a reporting or dashboard role. Your mission is to help the product teams deeply understand how our features are used by our customers, what value they create, and how they can make money. You will turn product and business data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations that shape what the company builds, how it is measured, and how it is monetized. In a world where AI can surface data, this role exists to answer the harder business questions: Who uses this feature and why? Is it creating value? And how can it make money? Key Responsibilities & Focus Areas Drive Strategic Direction, Not Just Feature Metrics: You won't just analyze isolated features—you will connect product performance directly to company-wide strategy. By uncovering the true business impact of what we build, your insights will shape executive decisions, guide product roadmaps, and directly influence Morning's long-term trajectory and growth Shape Product & Strategic Direction: Go beyond isolated feature tracking to connect product performance directly to company strategy, ensuring every development choice informs the broader roadmap and long-term business trajectory. Act as a Strategic Product Partner: Embed yourself in the daily rhythms of Product and Scrum teams, bringing a high-level business and data perspective to shape feature concepts into core strategic drivers. Evaluate Holistic Value & Ecosystem Impact: Analyze usage patterns and user journeys to understand how features contribute to overall platform engagement, long-term retention, and compounding business value Scale Monetization & Business Models: Translate product behavior into comprehensive revenue strategies, connecting feature engagement directly to pricing structures, monetization opportunities, and company-wide growth. Challenge Assumptions & Drive Core Focus: Use rigorous data insights to question legacy beliefs, helping leadership and product teams prioritize high-impact initiatives and define where to double down or pivot. Requirements: Who You Are? Analytically Fearless: 3 years in an analytical role (product analytics, business analytics, or similar) within a SaaS, fintech, or B2B environment. Technical Pro: High-level SQL is your second language. Experience with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel) and BI tools (Databricks / AWS QuickSight / Power BI), and strong Excel/spreadsheet modeling skills. Business-minded: Strong business acumen - you think in trade-offs, value, and revenue, not just metrics. You understand SaaS business models and key metrics (ARPU, conversion, churn, LTV) and how product behavior drives them. Deep understanding of vanity metrics vs. real value, and correlation vs. causation (A/B tests, cohorts, pre/post analysis). You simplify the complex. You don't just analyze data; you extract the 'so what' and help the team decide what to build and how to monetize it. A Natural Communicator & Team Player: You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, developers, and designers. You present insights simply and help the team turn them into decisions. Educational Background: Degree in Economics, Industrial Engineering, Statistics, or Business Management. Advantages: Experience with monetization or pricing analysis.

The role combines the management of specialized research assignments, collaboration with professional partners and vendors, and the use of diverse research tools, sources, and methodologies. The Analyst will integrate information and findings from different sources and areas of expertise, identify relationships, patterns, and trends, and transform them into a clear picture that supports assessments and decision-making. The role requires research and operational experience, technological understanding, the ability to manage external interfaces, sound judgment, and discretion when handling sensitive information. Plan and coordinate tailored research approaches using providers, sources, and professional capabilities suited to the requirements of each assignment. Integrate findings into a clear research picture and prepare assessments, profiles, and briefings for the intelligence team and internal stakeholders. Manage the quality of work performed by providers and professional partners, including monitoring compliance with requirements, timelines, and expected deliverable standards. Previous experience in an intelligence role within a relevant state, government, or public-sector environment. In-depth understanding and practical research experience across the Dark Web, closed digital communities, social media, and online communication platforms. Experience conducting human-source research (HUMINT), interviews, or structured professional engagement with relevant sources. Experience managing research firms, information providers, and external professional capabilities, including tasking, professional oversight, and deliverable assessment. Demonstrated ability to verify and cross-reference information, integrate findings from different sources, and develop a clear research picture. Full professional proficiency in Russian, including the ability to read, understand, and analyze complex content. Excellent command of English, including the ability to write, brief, and present findings to a high professional standard. Strong familiarity with cyber intelligence sources, digital environments, and technological tools used for research and information collection. Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive information and complex assignments responsibly. Ability to work independently and manage multiple assignments while meeting deadlines and adapting to changing priorities. Responsibilities: Cohort LTV & Churn Prediction. A per-player risk score for depositors, labelled against repeat-deposit KPIs—wired to real interventions, and cohort-level LTV:CAC maturation modelling to tell marketing in-month whether a cohort will pay back within a year. CRM & Lifecycle Optimization. Building models to trigger personalized Push and Email notifications at the exact right moment, matching the right communication journeys to the player's specific lifecycle stage and behavior. Deposit-after-N-days-without-deposit probability. A conditional/hazard model for the likelihood a lapsed depositor deposits again given N days of inactivity — feeding RV model targeting and treatment timing. Lobby suggestion. Which tournaments and which entry-fee tiers to surface to which player. Today the lobby is driven by hand-built segmentation rules; we want a learned ranking model that trades off engagement, monetization, and matchmaking liquidity. Store suggestion. Personalized offer and pack ranking in the store, replacing static store-segmentation configs — picking the right offer, at the right price point, at the right moment. Requirements: 4+ years of applied data science in growth, monetization, retention or lifecycle — with models you personally got into production and can point to a business decision they changed. Prior domain experience is required, not a bonus: mobile gaming, real-money gaming/iGaming, or a consumer app with a live in-app economy. You should already think in LTV, ARPDAU, D-n retention, offer elasticity, entry fees and payback windows without being taught the vocabulary. Hands-on propensity, churn, uplift, survival/hazard and LTV modelling. Recommendation or ranking experience is a strong plus. Python at production quality (LightGBM/XGBoost; PyTorch or TensorFlow for embedding-based work) and strong warehouse SQL (Snowflake, BigQuery). Real experimentation depth — designed tests, sized them, and read them honestly. Including at least one case where a clean A/B wasn't available and you still produced a defensible impact claim.

Experience level: Senior. Description: About the role • We are looking for an Analytics Lead to join our Data team in Tel Aviv, and to be the senior voice on product and business analytics of the company. • You own the systems and narratives that turn our data into commercial outcomes: less churn, more expansion, faster sales, and smarter testing across the merchant portfolio. You join a small, full-stack data team and work across the analyst domains it touches (CS, CRO, Sales, SaaS metrics, finance, marketing). This is a hands-on lead role: you ship the work yourself and set the analytical quality bar others work to. You are self-driving and curious, and you act as a force multiplier who roughly doubles what the rest of the company can do with data and insight. It is a senior individual-contributor role: no direct reports, real influence. • What you'll own • SaaS metrics, end to end. Own MRR, NRR, GRR, churn dollars, CAC, LTV, and payback, the monthly business close to Finance, and the metric definitions behind them. • Product analytics. Own how PDQ measures its own product (feature adoption, activation, impact) and the definitions behind it, moving it from reporting to decisions. • A/B learning that compound. Build the repository that mines patterns across wins and losses portfolio-wide, and feed the best ones back into the product and our AI agent. • A CRO framework for 200+ merchants. Design the system that scales (segmentation, opportunity scoring, recommended strategies, expected impact, measurement) and let our AI agent and CSMs run per-merchant execution on it. • Churn prevention, not churn reporting. Build the closed loop from churn signal to intervention to outcome, partnered with our data science team. Define what "saved" means and measure it. • Post-activation ROI and expansion. Quantify the value each merchant gets after go-live and turn it into a live per-merchant scorecard Sales and CS use in renewals and upsells. • Win/loss. Stand up the program from scratch: intake with Sales, a taxonomy, and a quarterly readout to leadership on why we win, why we lose, and what to change. • The Sales and CS partnership. Be the data team's primary partner to both, with a real feedback loop from the field into analysis. • Requirements: • 6+ years in applied analytics in SaaS, a product company, or e-commerce, with DTC, e-commerce, or B2B2C experience strongly preferred. • Full-stack analyst range: BI, data modeling, product analytics, experimentation and A/B testing, applied statistics, and churn analysis, with real depth in more than one of CS, CRO, Sales, SaaS metrics, finance, and marketing analytics. • A/B testing experience. This one is required: you have designed and analyzed experiments and can separate a real effect from noise. • Strong SQL and comfort in Python. Much of the technical part of analysis today is AI-generated. That reliance creates room for lower standards; we expect the opposite, so you read it closely and challenge it rather than trust it. • Stakeholder fluency: comfortable with a CFO, a Sales VP, and a CSM in the same hour, fluent in the KPIs each lives by, and able to communicate in business language rather than p-values. • A closed-loop instinct: not "report a metric" but "what changes because of this," with accountability for every number you ship. • A clear view of where AI helps analytics and where it creates risk, and the rigor to reject sloppy output. • High integrity, strong attention to detail, but equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and doing hands‑on work. • Ability to work in our Tel Aviv office, four days a week • Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) • Strong advantages: Snowflake experience, and a real passion for online shopping, e-commerce, and consumer psychology, with genuine curiosity about how DTC shoppers behave. Also a plus: churn modeling, LTV/pLTV, win/loss frameworks, or B2B SaaS expansion analytics. •

Responsibilities Recommendation & Personalization: Own recommendation and personalization across the entire user journey: which series or episode to watch next, how series are ordered on screen, when and how notifications are sent, when a popup appears mid-viewing, which pricing offer a specific user sees - and more, as new surfaces come online. Predictive Modeling: Turn raw behavioral data into predictive models for retention, churn, and conversion propensity. Predicted LTV (pLTV) is especially critical here - both to power personalization and as a signal we feed back to ad networks to help them find higher-quality users. Applied Model Adaptation: Take existing models and architectures and adapt or fine-tune them to our data - applied, not from-scratch research. Production Ownership: Ship models to production and own them end-to-end: serving, monitoring, retraining, and iteration. Experimentation: Design and read experiments (A/B, causal) to prove real business lift, not offline metrics alone. Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Product, Content, and Growth to turn model outputs into decisions. Beyond Rule-Based Analytics: Replace hand-tuned heuristics with models that learn. Requirements: BSc in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or Mathematics (must). MSc or PhD is a strong plus. 5+ years of working experience in Data Science or Machine Learning, shipping models to production. Direct, hands-on experience building recommendation and/or personalization systems in production (a firm requirement, not a nice-to-have). Strong applied ML / data science foundations: modeling, evaluation, feature engineering. Neural networks and deep learning (must): hands-on experience training and adapting deep learning models for real-world production use. Time series data (must): hands-on experience modeling temporal data, including forecasting, trends, seasonality, and noisy real-world signals. Ability to take a model or architecture and adapt it to real, messy data - practical, not purely theoretical. Production and engineering chops: get models serving reliably and keep iterating. Experimentation discipline: A/B testing, causal reasoning, honest metrics. Data fluency: SQL and large data warehouses, comfortable in the raw data. Clear communication and a bias to ship. Huge Advantage - industry experience: Recsys at scale: retrieval / ranking, sequence or session models, embeddings. LTV, churn, or propensity modeling in a consumer / subscription product. Streaming, entertainment, consumer / mobile, or growth-marketing data. MLOps: feature stores, model serving, monitoring, retraining pipelines. Causal inference / uplift modeling.

ABOUT BRANDLIGHT Brandlight is the leading enterprise AI visibility platform, built to help the world’s leading brands understand, manage, and optimize how they appear across AI-driven search, commerce, and advertising. As AI rapidly becomes a trillion-dollar marketing and distribution channel, Brandlight is defining the systems that decide how brands are surfaced, trusted, and chosen. Join our team and help build the next generation of tools shaping the future of brand management in an AI-first world. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Data Analyst who combines analytical rigor, strong business judgment, and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. This role spans three core areas: marketing analytics for our clients, product analytics for Brandlight, and modeling consumer behavior in AI chats using panel data. You’ll help clients understand marketing effectiveness through attribution, marketing mix modeling, and incrementally analysis. Internally, you’ll analyze product clickstream data to understand how customers use Brandlight and identify opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Alongside this, you’ll analyze panel and conversational data to understand how people discover brands, explore options, and progress through decision-making journeys in AI chats. You’ll own analytical projects end to end from defining the question and preparing the data to developing analytical models, validating findings, and influencing decisions. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between business questions, event-level data, and statistical analysis and take ownership before every requirement has been defined. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own analytical quality and communication. - Marketing Analyst - Analyze marketing performance on behalf of clients, own attribution and marketing effectiveness analyses, turning measurement into client decisions. - Brandlight Product Analytics - Understand how customers use our product, Guiding product decisions through evidence while Building a reliable foundation for product measurement. - Panel Data & AI-Chat Behavioral Modeling - Analyze how people use AI chats, modeling it using intent taxonomies, behavioral segments, etc. Produce robust, representative insights. REQUIREMENTS - 4+ years of experience in data analytics, with a track record of independently delivering analyses that influenced marketing, product, or business decisions. - Advanced SQL skills. - Strong Python or R skills - Hands-on product analytics experience with event-based platforms. - Strong statistical foundations, including regression, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, experimental design, and model validation. - Strong visualization and stakeholder communication skills. - Proactive ownership, curiosity, and attention to detail. ADVANTAGE - Experience analyzing panel or longitudinal behavioral data. - Hands-on marketing analytics experience (MTA, MMM, and incrementality measurement, etc.) - Experience in advertising technology, consumer intelligence, market research, or enterprise SaaS, with familiarity with analytical warehouses and version-controlled analytics workflows. WHY JOIN US At Brandlight, you’ll build and shape a new category at the intersection of AI, marketing, and commerce. We’re a fast-growing startup led by repeat entrepreneurs, world-class engineers, and marketing leaders, all driven to reinvent how brands are built, discovered, and chosen in the age of AI.

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way . Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward. About us JLL (NYSE: JLL) is a Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate. We are a $20B+ business with over 100,000 employees worldwide and the stability and resources to invest seriously in AI. Under our Accelerate 2030 strategy, data and AI are the core pillars of how the company will operate and grow. The Tel Aviv technology hub is at the center of that effort. We design, build, and operate production-grade AI systems that shape how decisions are made across JLL's diverse businesses. The position We are looking for a Data Science Manager to join the Enterprise Data Science Group to serve as a senior, hands-on manager and the group lead's close partner. You'll start by leading multiple strong data scientists internationally, driving several of our applied research tracks, with a clear mandate to grow the team in Tel Aviv as new projects land: hiring, setting vision and roadmaps, and aligning stakeholders on goals and KPIs. One of the most ambitious parts of the roadmap is building custom language models for JLL, models adapted to commercial real estate on proprietary data few companies can match for various use cases. The role offers a rare combination of hard, real-world applied research, leadership, and the full stack including dozens of data sources, billions of data points, closed and open-weight LLMs, post-training/fine-tuning, agentic workflows, multiple cloud environments, and more. You'll partner with strong data scientists, engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders and see your work land in production. Representative projects: Classifying companies by industry code at scale, combining LLMs, custom embeddings, and classic ML. GenAI-based entity resolution, linking companies and properties across dozens of data sources using custom embeddings, deep pipelines, LLMs at scale, fine-tuning, clustering, and more. Agentic, LLM-based, and ML-driven recommender systems for driving cross-sell and up-sell across our diverse businesses. Forecasting commercial lease rent dynamics and market trends from JLL's global transaction and market data using millions of leases and diverse input. Building agents and MCP servers that put our research and data to work. Exploratory research for incorporating the latest approaches (tabular foundation models, time-series foundation models, multi-agent pipelines, reinforcement learning, auto-research, novel evaluation methods, etc.) into our work. We are looking for: 2+ years managing data scientists, AI researchers, ML engineers or similar. Strong leadership mentality where you inspire your team, initiate beyond core data science, and partner with product and business to spot new project opportunities. Proven ML/AI excellence, with recent years focused on GenAI. A track record of leading multi-person efforts end-to-end, shipping to production, and creating lasting value. Comfortable with communicating your work internally and externally. A strong research track record (e.g., scientific publications, technical reports/blogs, conference talks). An MSc (PhD an advantage) in computer science, math, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Ways to stand out: Hands-on post-training of open-weight models (e.g. Llama/Qwen-class): SFT, preference optimization (DPO/GRPO), LoRA vs. full fine-tuning, and synthetic data curation Distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed) or high-throughput LLM serving (vLLM, SGLang) Experience with agentic systems: tools and MCP design, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering, and rigorous evaluation An entrepreneurial track record We're a tight-knit team of about 20 with a strong, fun, collaborative culture and a positive atmosphere, hybrid from our newly renovated Tel Aviv headquarters, a homelike space with team breakfasts and an on-site gym. We offer highly competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance. Location: On-site –TEL AVIV, ISR If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table! At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing. JLL Privacy Notice Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL), together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading global provider of real estate and investment management services. We take our responsibility to protect the personal information provided to us seriously. JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way . Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Senior Data Scientist (Hybrid) – Tel Aviv About us JLL (NYSE: JLL) is a Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate. We are a $20B+ business with over 100,000 employees worldwide and the stability and resources to invest seriously in AI. Under our Accelerate 2030 strategy, data and AI are the core pillars of how the company will operate and grow. The Tel Aviv technology hub is at the center of that effort. We design, build, and operate production-grade AI systems that shape how decisions are made across JLL's diverse businesses. The position We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Enterprise Data Science Group — an outstanding data scientist who thrives on complex problems that require critical thinking and rigorous evaluation, the kind that can’t be solved out of the box with vibe coding. You’ll code solutions end-to-end and shape how machine learning and AI drive business value at scale. You'll work across the full stack: dozens of data sources, billions of data points, closed and open-weight LLMs, fine-tuning LLMs, agentic workflows, and multiple cloud environments. Most of your projects go past research and into production, where the rest of the business depends on them. Representative projects: GenAI-based entity resolution, linking companies and properties across dozens of sources using custom embeddings, LLMs at scale, fine-tuning, and clustering. AI-generated global company taxonomies that rival purchased third-party solutions, across millions of companies and their domestic and global hierarchies. Agentic, LLM-based, and ML-driven recommender systems for driving cross-sell and up-sell across our businesses. Forecasting commercial lease rent dynamics and market trends from millions of leases and JLL's global transaction data. Agents and MCP servers that put our research and data to work, plus exploratory tracks on tabular and time-series foundation models, multi-agent pipelines, reinforcement learning, and novel evaluation. We are looking for 5+ years of industry experience, with original research and/or ML/AI solutions deployed in production. Sound judgment in choosing the approach for the situation: when to use frontier model APIs, fine-tuned open-weight models, agentic workflows, classical ML, etc. Strong foundations in ML and statistics. A solid understanding of transformers and LLM internals, from attention, tokenization, and embeddings to how models are post-trained and served. A rigorous evaluation mindset across classical and non-deterministic systems: error analysis, benchmark creation and ground-truth design, LLM-as-judge with human calibration. Hands-on experience with agentic systems: tools and MCP design, RAG, multi-agent orchestration, and context engineering. An MSc (PhD an advantage) in computer science, mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Ways to stand out Experience post-training open-weight models (e.g. Llama/Qwen-class): SFT, preference optimization and RL (DPO, GRPO, RLVR), LoRA vs. full fine-tuning, and synthetic data curation. Hands-on experience scaling LLMs in training and inference: distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed), high-throughput serving (vLLM, SGLang), quantization (FP8/INT4), and KV-cache optimization. Engineering with data at scale: pipelines, production deployment, and owning cost, latency, and monitoring in the cloud. A public research footprint including publications, technical blogs, or conference talks. We're a tight-knit team of about 20 with a strong, fun, collaborative culture and a positive atmosphere, hybrid from our newly renovated Tel Aviv headquarters, a homelike space with team breakfasts and an on-site gym. We offer highly competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance. Location: On-site –TEL AVIV, ISR If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements. Mobileye is looking for a hands-on Senior Technical Product Analyst to join the team developing a novel approach to validating the safety of autonomous vehicles. The core focus of this role is SOTIF (Safety of the Intended Functionality), combining deep technical analysis with customer engagement to shape practical safety and validation solutions. Demonstrating the safety of autonomous vehicle systems is one of the most challenging problems at the frontier of technology. It requires a deep end-to-end understanding of the AV system, rigorous technical analysis, and the ability to translate safety challenges into measurable KPIs, practical tools, and scalable methodologies. In this role, you will work closely with R&D, Validation, customers, and industry stakeholders to shape and advance Mobileye’s SOTIF approach and support its broad acceptance across the automotive industry. Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution! What will your job look like? Lead the design & development SOTIF (Safety Of The Intended Functionality) concept and KPIs for AV systems. Work closely with R&D and validation on bringing our concepts to reality. Initiate new methods and tools to support the safety analysis of the AV system. Hands-on development of tools, analysis and solutions together with an Agile team. Identify potential safety risks , such as driver behavior, and develop strategies to mitigate those risks. Develop and implement SOTIF requirements and guidelines for the design, development, and testing of systems. Work with the automotive industry to get to a wide acceptance of our methodology. Work closely with customers and regulators on SOTIF related aspects. All you need is: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 5+ years of experience in development or product management of SW\systems. Significant experience in building technical solutions with AI . Skills in Python or other scripting language. Knowledge of SQL . Knowledge in statistical modeling and DOE. Experience with implementation of regulation strategy. Analytical and problem-solving skills to identify SOTIF risks and develop solutions. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Excellent leadership and teamwork skills to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Strong time management and organizational skills to meet regulation deadlines. Motivation to help shape the future of safe autonomous mobility. Nice to have: In-depth knowledge of SOTIF concepts and standards, such as ISO / PAS 21448 and UL 4600. Expertise in safety-critical system design and development processes. Familiarity with safety analysis methods, such as hazard analysis and risk assessment. Strong coding skills. Statistics tools experience and skills.

We are looking for a Senior GenAI Data Scientist with strong hands-on experience in GenAI red teaming, adversarial testing, machine learning, and large-scale data analysis. You will develop the data science and ML capabilities behind an automated GenAI red-teaming platform. You will analyze and cluster adversarial prompts, identify emerging attack patterns, build models for automated prompt generation and mutation, and develop data-driven methods for prioritizing and evaluating security risks across different AI models. We are looking for a hands-on technologist with deep expertise in data science: clustering, scaling, machine learning, and statistical analysis. Key Responsibilities Build agents that act as data scientists at scale, reasoning, planning, and executing multi-step workflows to generate and analyze adversarial attacks. Manage and analyze prompt and response data from multiple sources (red-team campaigns, model evaluations, synthetic attacks); clean, curate, normalize, and label it for analysis. Analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data to uncover trends, clusters, and anomalies, such as attack families, jailbreak techniques, and previously unseen patterns. Develop ML models and predictive algorithms to automate red-teaming. Build evaluation and monitoring pipelines to measure attack success and track model behavior across models and providers. Use statistical techniques and experiments to validate findings and ensure accuracy and reproducibility. Take research to production: build reliable, scalable systems optimized for cost and latency, with solid engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, telemetry). Requirements Must-Have M.Sc. in CS/EE/Math/Statistics or a related field; Ph.D. is an advantage. 5+ years of hands-on data science or ML experience, programming in Python or R, and SQL. 3+ years of experience with Scikit-Learn and PyTorch. Hands-on experience in GenAI red teaming, adversarial testing, or LLM security. Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered or ML systems in production. Strong understanding of LLM design patterns, including prompt engineering, tool calling, structured outputs, and RAG. Strong grasp of clustering, embeddings/NLP, semantic similarity, and anomaly/novelty detection. Experience building classification, ranking, or prioritization systems. Solid background in statistics, experimental design, and model evaluation. Experience with Cradle, Apache Hadoop, and Spark, and with scaling ETL and data pipelines. Nice-to-Have Experience building LLM agents or multi-agent workflows with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK. Familiarity with evaluation frameworks, MLOps pipelines, and AI observability tooling. Data visualization with Tableau, Power BI, or matplotlib. Experience with AWS, including Lambda, S3, and EC2. Experience running inference on GenAI models via Hugging Face, Bedrock, and Azure. Background in Trust & Safety, security, or regulated environments. Alice is the leading provider of security and safety solutions for online experiences, safeguarding more than 3 billion users, top foundation models, and the world's largest enterprises every day. Through Real-Time Guardrails and continuous Red Teaming, backed by deep threat intelligence and coverage of 117+ languages, Alice helps AI, security, and policy teams build GenAI products that stay safe at global scale. About Alice THE CHALLENGES ALONG THE WAY 1. Being Both Strategist and Executioner One of the hardest parts of this role is that you’re both the visionary and the builder; the one drawing the map and paving the road. That means switching between high-level strategy and hands-on experimentation daily, and doing it while bringing others along with you. There’s no playbook for this kind of work. You’re paving an unpaved road, one small experiment at a time. ‍ 2. Balancing Security and Innovation ActiveFence is the leading provider of security and safety solutions for online experiences, safeguarding more than 3 billion users, top foundation models, and the world’s largest enterprises and tech platforms every day. As a trusted ally to major technology firms and Fortune 500 brands that build user-generated and GenAI products, ActiveFence empowers security, AI, and policy teams with low-latency Real-Time Guardrails and a continuous Red Teaming program that pressure-tests systems with adversarial prompts and emerging threat techniques. Powered by deep threat intelligence, unmatched harmful-content detection, and coverage of 117+ languages, ActiveFence enables organizations to deliver engaging and trustworthy experiences at global scale while operating safely and responsibly across all threat landscapes. ℹ️ How the tags on this board are computed

Everything is extracted deterministically from the posting text — a fixed keyword lexicon and header rules, no AI guessing. A tag can be missing simply because the posting never stated it; postings without a captured description show no tags at all.

Skills are matched from a curated 98-term lexicon and grouped into non-overlapping clusters: SQL & Databases, ETL & Infrastructure, Coding, ML & Statistics, Visualization & BI, Other. Hover any tag for its meaning.

MUST / PLUS badges mirror the posting’s own wording (“a must”, “an advantage”, חובה / יתרון) — absence of a badge means the posting didn’t mark that line. Years is the experience figure stated nearest to “experience”. Degree shows the level and fields asked for; “plus” means the posting itself calls the degree an advantage.

Day-to-day groups classify the responsibilities section: Instrument & manage tracking (Setting up event tracking, taxonomies and instrumentation) · Assure data quality (Validation, anomaly detection, alerting — keeping the data trustworthy) · Run experiments & build models (A/B tests, statistical models and forecasts) · Define metrics & KPIs (Owning metric definitions — the single source of truth for KPIs) · Build pipelines & data models (ETL, warehouse models and analytical infrastructure) · Build dashboards & track performance (Dashboards, recurring reports and performance tracking) · Analyze & recommend (Deep dives and analysis that end in insights and recommendations) · Partner & present (Working with business teams — gathering needs, presenting findings). A chip appears only when a group matches multiple responsibility bullets — it marks an emphasis of the role, not a passing mention — and chips are ordered by how dominant each theme is.

🤖 AI usage classifies what the analyst is expected to do with AI, judged from the words around each AI mention: AI for efficiency (Expected to use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor…) to work faster) · AI for automation (Using AI to automate processes and workflows) · Building with AI (Building AI/LLM-powered features, models or data products) · AI (unspecified) (AI named as a requirement without a stated purpose). WHERE the mention sits matters: in the requirements section it is prior experience you must bring; in the responsibilities it is part of the job — learnable, not a bar to entry. The dashboard and chips keep the two apart. Mentions of the company’s own AI product (“analyze our AI agents”) are deliberately NOT counted — that is product analysis, not AI usage.

Soft skills (dotted chips) are tagged from the requirements section only — the person the posting describes, separate from the toolbox: communication, ownership, business acumen, curiosity, and so on. Hover any chip for its meaning.
